correctness.rationale: Exact equivalence of type-2 e-harmonicity for n=m^2 to product(p+1)|2^omega(m)m^2. Least-prime reasoning forces m=1 or 6|m and q in {5,7,11,23}; with four supports, r+1|48q^2 forces r<25392. Integer-only exhaustive code under this proven bound returns exactly nine four-support bases, and an independent direct exponential-divisor regression agrees over all squarefree bases <=12000. Infinite claims rely on the proof, not finite samples.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The broader source definitions and e-perfect claims do not cover non-e-perfect type-2 squares; exponential-unitary divisors and a squarefree cofactor define different functions and exponents, so the checked stronger-looking theorems do not imply this classification.

value.rationale: Natural first nonsquarefree all-exponent-2 layer for exponential divisors. A global, sharp, four-element least-additional-prime spectrum is established for arbitrary many prime factors; a full exact classification of all bases with at most four distinct primes yields nine exceptional four-support bases and a proof-derived finite cutoff, not a numerical table increment or a restatement of the known example 900. The fixed exponent layer, low-support classification and constraints on arbitrary supports are intrinsically motivated; no downstream theorem is claimed.
